items.title: The henselization and strict henselization maps are formally etale and formally smooth
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the maps from a local ring to its henselization and to its strict henselization, and from the henselization to the strict henselization, are formally etale, and hence formally smooth for the relevant adic topologies. The proof reads formal etaleness off the construction of the henselizations as directed colimits of etale algebras, using that etale algebras are formally etale and that colimits of formally etale algebras are formally etale, and then obtains formal smoothness for the adic topologies from the implication formal etale implies formally smooth together with the comparison between algebraic formal smoothness and its adic version.
